blocks.en: If $\Omega$ and the coefficients satisfy the relevant smoothness assumptions, then the assumptions of Theorem~\ref{thm:agmon-douglis-nirenberg-elliptic-estimate} apply for every $t\in[0,1]$; hence the Fredholm index for $(L,B)$ is the same as for Laplace\textquotesingle s equation. In Section~\ref{sec:dirichlet-existence-and-uniqueness}, we proved that the problem $\Delta u=f$ with boundary condition $u=0$ has a unique solution $u\in H^1(\Omega)$ for every $f\in H^{-1}(\Omega)$. Using the inverse trace theorem, we can trivially conclude that there is a unique solution $u\in H^1(\Omega)$ of the problem $\Delta u=f$, $u|_{\partial\Omega}=g$ for every $f\in H^{-1}(\Omega)$, $g\in H^{1/2}(\Omega)$. What we would now like to know is that if $f\in L^2(\Omega)$ and $g\in H^{3/2}(\Omega)$, then $u\in H^2(\Omega)$. This is a statement much along the lines of the first assertion of Theorem~\ref{thm:agmon-douglis-nirenberg-elliptic-estimate}, but is not actually implied by Theorem~\ref{thm:agmon-douglis-nirenberg-elliptic-estimate}. The reason is that for the Dirichlet problem of Laplace\textquotesingle s equation, we would choose $s_1=0$, $t_1=2$ and $r_1=-2$, making $M_1=0$ and $X_{M_1}=H^2(\Omega)$. Hence the theorem asserts higher regularity of $H^2$ solutions if the data are appropriate, but not $H^2$ regularity of $H^1$ solutions. Nevertheless, the regularity of weak solutions can be proved along very similar lines as Theorem~\ref{thm:agmon-douglis-nirenberg-elliptic-estimate}, and Agmon, Douglis and Nirenberg actually state such results for scalar elliptic equations. For second-order equations with Dirichlet conditions, see Sections~\ref{sec:elliptic-interior-regularity} and \ref{sec:elliptic-boundary-regularity}.
blocks.zh: 若 $\Omega$ 和系数满足相应的光滑性假设, 则对每个 $t\in[0,1]$, Theorem~\ref{thm:agmon-douglis-nirenberg-elliptic-estimate} 的假设均适用; 因而 $(L,B)$ 的 Fredholm 指标与 Laplace 方程的相同. 在 Section~\ref{sec:dirichlet-existence-and-uniqueness} 中已经证明, 对每个 $f\in H^{-1}(\Omega)$, 问题 $\Delta u=f$ 在边界条件 $u=0$ 下有唯一解 $u\in H^1(\Omega)$. 利用逆迹定理, 容易得到对每个 $f\in H^{-1}(\Omega)$, $g\in H^{1/2}(\Omega)$, 问题 $\Delta u=f$, $u|_{\partial\Omega}=g$ 有唯一解 $u\in H^1(\Omega)$. 现在希望知道, 若 $f\in L^2(\Omega)$ 且 $g\in H^{3/2}(\Omega)$, 是否就有 $u\in H^2(\Omega)$. 这与 Theorem~\ref{thm:agmon-douglis-nirenberg-elliptic-estimate} 的第一项断言十分相近, 但实际上并不能由 Theorem~\ref{thm:agmon-douglis-nirenberg-elliptic-estimate} 推出. 原因是, 对 Laplace 方程的 Dirichlet 问题, 应选取 $s_1=0$, $t_1=2$ 和 $r_1=-2$, 从而 $M_1=0$ 且 $X_{M_1}=H^2(\Omega)$. 因此, 该定理断言数据适当时 $H^2$ 解具有更高正则性, 而不是断言 $H^1$ 解具有 $H^2$ 正则性. 尽管如此, 可以沿着与 Theorem~\ref{thm:agmon-douglis-nirenberg-elliptic-estimate} 非常相似的思路证明弱解的正则性, 而 Agmon, Douglis 和 Nirenberg 实际上也对标量椭圆方程陈述了这样的结果. 具有 Dirichlet 条件的二阶方程参见 Sections~\ref{sec:elliptic-interior-regularity} 和 \ref{sec:elliptic-boundary-regularity}.

blocks.en: A natural question is now to ask for a class of problems to which the approach of Section~\ref{sec:dirichlet-existence-and-uniqueness}, based on the Lax--Milgram lemma, can be extended. This will lead us to Agmon\textquotesingle s condition, to be discussed in Subsection~\ref{subsec:agmon-condition-coercive-problems}. The Lax--Milgram lemma will imply existence of a ``weak\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ solution, and again the regularity of weak solutions has to be addressed before Theorem~\ref{thm:agmon-douglis-nirenberg-elliptic-estimate} is applicable.
blocks.zh: 现在自然要问, 基于 Lax--Milgram 引理的 Section~\ref{sec:dirichlet-existence-and-uniqueness} 中的方法可以推广到哪一类问题. 这将引向 Subsection~\ref{subsec:agmon-condition-coercive-problems} 将讨论的 Agmon 条件. Lax--Milgram 引理将给出一个 ``弱\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ 解的存在性, 而在应用 Theorem~\ref{thm:agmon-douglis-nirenberg-elliptic-estimate} 之前, 仍然必须处理弱解的正则性.

blocks.en: Another interesting question is to characterize the orthogonal complement of the range of $\mathcal{A}$; i.e., what conditions must $\bm{f}$ and $\bm{g}$ satisfy so that the problem $\bm{L}\bm{u}=\bm{f}$ with boundary conditions $\bm{B}\bm{u}=\bm{g}$ is solvable? Usually, one can find a $\bm{u}$ satisfying $\bm{B}\bm{u}=\bm{g}$ by an application of the inverse trace theorem (see next subsection, Subsection~\ref{subsec:adjoint-boundary-value-problem}); hence we are reduced to the case $\bm{g}=0$. This leaves us with the question of characterizing those $\bm{v}$ for which $(\bm{v},\bm{L}\bm{u})=0$ for every $\bm{u}$ satisfying $\bm{B}\bm{u}=0$. By formally integrating by parts, one can obtain an elliptic boundary-value problem for $\bm{v}$, known as the adjoint boundary-value problem. We shall study adjoint boundary-value problems for scalar elliptic equations in the next subsection. Of course, a priori $\bm{v}$ will satisfy the adjoint boundary-value problem only in a ``weak\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ or ``generalized\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ sense. Hence the regularity of weak solutions becomes again an important issue. In particular, in order to show that the operator $\mathcal{A}$ is Fredholm, one has to show that the nullspace of the adjoint is finite-dimensional. Of course, one has to show this for weak solutions of the adjoint problem, not just for strong solutions. Indeed, it is possible to prove this. If the coefficients are smooth enough, it turns out that weak solutions of the adjoint problem are actually smooth.
blocks.zh: 另一个有趣的问题是刻画 $\mathcal{A}$ 的值域的正交补; 即 $\bm{f}$ 和 $\bm{g}$ 必须满足什么条件, 问题 $\bm{L}\bm{u}=\bm{f}$ 才能在边界条件 $\bm{B}\bm{u}=\bm{g}$ 下可解? 通常, 应用逆迹定理就能找到满足 $\bm{B}\bm{u}=\bm{g}$ 的 $\bm{u}$ (见下一小节, Subsection~\ref{subsec:adjoint-boundary-value-problem}); 因而归结为 $\bm{g}=0$ 的情形. 于是剩下的问题是刻画这样的 $\bm{v}$: 对每个满足 $\bm{B}\bm{u}=0$ 的 $\bm{u}$, 都有 $(\bm{v},\bm{L}\bm{u})=0$. 形式地分部积分可以得到关于 $\bm{v}$ 的椭圆边值问题, 称为伴随边值问题. 下一小节将研究标量椭圆方程的伴随边值问题. 当然, 先验而言, $\bm{v}$ 只在 ``弱\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ 或 ``广义\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ 意义下满足伴随边值问题. 因此弱解的正则性再次成为重要问题. 特别地, 为证明算子 $\mathcal{A}$ 为 Fredholm 算子, 必须证明伴随算子的零空间有限维. 当然, 必须对伴随问题的弱解证明这一点, 而不能仅对强解证明. 事实上可以证明这一点. 若系数足够光滑, 则伴随问题的弱解实际上是光滑的.
